text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: O luggage—pack! Alstroemeria! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm all ready for summer<n>camp! Looks like
speed magic is<n>pretty handy for packing, too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Doggy? While I'm out for<n>camp, it'll be your
job to stand guard<n>over this roo—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you wanna come with me?<n>Hmph, you're
such a wimp. I guess<n>I'll take you along then!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, my summer camp with<n>Sweep Tosho
begins.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
How Umamusume spend their time<n>here is
important, so I put a lot of<n>effort into planning the
best training<n>menu I could.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant...Pant... Ugh, it's sooo hot!
choice_data_list: Well done, now go take a break in the shade!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Glug... glug... Ahhh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey familiar, where're you<n>going?!
choice_data_list: Just getting ready! Sweep, you rest!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez, as long as you don't work<n>yourself ragged...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You tell me to rest, but you're the one<n>running
around everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...When are you supposed to take a<n>break? Doggy,
you think so too, don't<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Local Lady A
text_block_list.text: It's real hot again today. On days likethis, you gotta drink that!

text_block_list.name: Local Lady B
text_block_list.text: Oh, the magic juice. Then we simplymust go to the mountains and gatherthe ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Magic?! Did I hear that right?!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the rest of the day, we keep on<n>working our
way through the training<n>menu I prepared...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right, here I go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having rested up, Sweep's able to<n>breeze through
the whole routine with<n>exceptional focus!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... That's everything... fortoday, right? Then I'm headed to themountains!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm free to do whatever I want after<n>practice,
aren't I? There's something<n>I gotta find in the
mountains!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, why'd you come with me!<n>This'd be way
faster by myself!
choice_data_list: I'd worry if you were alone.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but who's the one<n>gasping for
breath?! I won't forgive<n>you if you slow me down!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! What's going on?! They<n>said you
could find it near the top!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nothing here, either... Ugh, why can't I<n>find it?!
choice_data_list: The sun's about to set, so—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, that's why I'm in a rush!<n>Stop complaining
and help me look!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Here, go look together with Doggy!<n>We're looking
for green, spiky<n>leaves!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The plushie in Sweep's hands has a<n>face that
seems to say, "Please put<n>up with her for a little
longer."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It has to be here! I swear upon thename of Magical Girl Sweepy that I'llfind it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing a great<n>witch-in-training can't
find... Huh?<n>Wait!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I found it! Look familiar, I finally found<n>it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After descending the mountain, she<n>told me to wait
a while, so here I am<n>taking a stroll on the beach—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, what're you doing here? You<n>even made me
look for you! Gosh,<n>the things I do for you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But rejoice, familiar! This is a<n>Sweepy-original
magical potion—just<n>for you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a potion made from local<n>medicinal herbs! I
even placed an<n>anti-heatstroke charm on it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So she went on that hiking trip to<n>gather herbs. If
this is meant to<n>prevent heatstroke, then Sweep
must've been worried about how I<n>was doing.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, it wasn't really for you—I was<n>only
practicing. I need to know if it<n>works, so drink it
already.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I hope you're ready, because it'sreally bitter!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just like she warned me, the magical<n>potion has a
rather acrid taste!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Familiar, you should see<n>your face!
Figures, since just a taste<n>had me gagging earlier.
choice_data_list: The flavor is really something... but I do feel better.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course you do—I'm a great<n>witch-in-training, after
all. Perfecting a<n>potion is as easy as pie!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, huge fireworks go<n>off, brightly
lighting up the evening<n>shore.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Pew... BOOM!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Big fireworks! Wowie, wow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I have to show Doggy this<n>too. Look,
these fireworks are<n>amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What, you got something to say,<n>Doggy?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, wrong again. Didn't I say it<n>wasn't for my
familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, nada, zilch! Actually, I still<n>have some
potion left, so you better<n>drink the rest tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho hugs her plushie tightly,<n>and under
the illumination of the<n>fireworks, I can see that her
cheeks<n>are flushed bright red.
